data.description:
Training system for medication education
   - Controller system (order output, object picking, drug mixing, patient administration)
   - Order (medication order) system
   - Evaluation system (accuracy of operation, time, sequence, drug mix accuracy)
ㅇ Educational content
  - Tutorial: VR device operation
  - Dosage 1.1 General drug administration 
  - Dosage 1.2 High-risk drug administration 
  - Medication 1.3 Emergency medication administration 
ㅇ System development
   - System advancement (UI/UX creation, medication order system, evaluation items)
   - Divided into two modes (training mode, challenge mode)
   - Pharmaceutical and medical device random placement system
   - Ranking system
   - Medical device (vial, syringe, IV, etc.) sticker replacement system (brand, capacity, language)
   - Multilingual system (Korean, English, Bednam)

changelog.change_log:
- NursingVR <V 0.9.11>
    - 주요 업데이트
        - 기능 추가 및 개선
            - 옵션 계정 연동
            - 로그인UI
                - 아이디 저장하기 토글버튼 추가 : 토글 해제하면 저장아이디를 공백문자로 저장
                - 패스워드 저장하기 토글버튼 추가 : 아이디 저장시에만 유효
                - 로그아웃 버튼을 UserID 아래에 추가
                - 로그아웃하시겠습니까? 확인 팝업 추가
                - 아이디/패스워드창 키보드 활성화시 해당 창 테두리 출력
              
        - 버그 수정
            - 새 기기로 첫 설치시 계정정보가 남아있는 문제
            - 시나리오
                - 자기 순서가 아닐 때 수액백의 수액세트 연결 마개 열었을 때 정상적으로 진행되지 않는 문제
                - 투약준비실에서 인벤토리에 뚜껑넣기전 펜을 넣었을 때 정상적으로 진행되지 않는 문제
                - 바닥에 떨어지지 않았는데 경고 멘트가 나오는 문제
                    - 소독필요할 때 [바닥에 떨어진 개봉 바이알은 입구 소독이 필요합니다.]  경고 멘트가 나오는 경우 체크
                - 고주의 펜형 펜니들 결합시 마개소독 안하면 정상적으로 진행되지 않는 문제
                - 간헐적으로 고주의 투약 완료 후 '솜 5초간 누르기' 실행 안 되는 문제
    
   **NursingVR <V 0.9.11>**

### Major Updates

### **Features Added and Improved**

- **Option Account Integration**
- **Login UI Enhancements**:
    - Added "Remember ID" toggle button: When toggled off, the saved ID is cleared.
    - Added "Save Password" toggle button: Only valid when "Remember ID" is enabled.
    - Added a Logout button below the User ID display.
    - Added a confirmation popup for "Are you sure you want to log out?".
    - Highlighted border on the ID/password fields when the keyboard is activated.

### **Bug Fixes**

- **Account Management**:
    - Resolved an issue where account information remained after the first installation on a new device.
- **Scenario Bugs**:
    - Fixed an issue where the process did not progress properly if the infusion bag's set connector cap was opened out of turn.
    - Fixed an issue in the medication preparation room where the process would not progress correctly if the pen was placed in the inventory before the cap.
    - Fixed a bug where warning messages appeared even though items had not fallen to the floor.
    - Checked scenarios where a warning message, "[The opening of a vial dropped to the floor needs to be disinfected.]," appeared unnecessarily.
    - Resolved an issue where the process did not proceed if the pen needle cap was not disinfected during pen-type syringe assembly for high-dose medication.
    - Addressed a bug where the "Press with cotton for 5 seconds" step intermittently failed to execute after completing a high-dose injection.
Modified the UI of the login interface
